The pleural spaces are clear, with sharp costophrenic and cardiophrenic angles bilaterally, which rules out the presence of pleural effusion or pneumothorax. The radiograph also shows some normal anatomical features and external artifacts. Prominent breast shadows are present at the lung bases; while these create a faint increase in density in the lower zones, they do not represent underlying pulmonary pathology. A single external cardiac monitoring electrode is visible on the right upper chest.
